explore_category_intro_quality_of_life: Small improvements that make everyday play easier: bigger stacks, faster crafting, cleaner menus and fewer chores.
explore_category_intro_gameplay: Mods that change how the game plays: difficulty, combat, enemies, survival rules and new mechanics.
explore_category_intro_building: Tools and pieces for builders: snapping, new structures and ways to shape your base.
explore_category_intro_companions: Kelvin, Virginia and other allies: smarter commands, new behaviours and more ways to travel together.
explore_category_intro_weapons_gear: New and tuned weapons, ammo, armour and gear for fighting and exploring.
explore_category_intro_vehicles_movement: Golf carts, gliders, knight suits and new ways to get around: speed, handling and traversal.
explore_category_intro_model_swap: Replace in-game models with new ones: characters, creatures, weapons and props.
explore_category_intro_ui_hud: HUD, map, minimap and menu mods that show you more and get in the way less.
explore_category_intro_menus_sandbox: Trainers, spawn menus and sandbox tools to experiment freely in single-player or as host.
explore_category_intro_multiplayer_serve: Mods for co-op sessions and dedicated servers: admin tools, sync fixes and player management.
explore_category_intro_library: Shared code other mods depend on. Install them when a mod lists them as a requirement.
explore_category_intro_misc: Mods that don’t fit anywhere else: experiments, utilities and one-off ideas.

explore_category_intro_builds_generic: BuildShare builds in the {category} category for Sons of the Forest, ready to place.
